title: Financial Analyst
description:
We’re helping an international finance and M&A consultancy find a Financial Analyst to support transaction advisory, fundraising, and strategic finance projects for high-growth startups and scaleups.

You’ll build sophisticated financial models, prepare investor and board materials, and support valuation and deal execution across software and deeptech companies. This is a hands‑on, high‑accountability role where flawless work is non‑negotiable — your analyses will directly inform key decisions and client strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is a wizard with numbers , detail‑obsessed yet commercially minded, and capable of seeing both the story and strategy behind the spreadsheets .

Part time to start, 24 hours/week (with potential to transition to full time)

Schedule: CET working hours

Location: Fully Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Compensation: $1440‑$2200 (based on a 24‑hour workweek, depending on level of experience); $2400‑$3680 for full time

Key Responsibilities
  • Build fully linked 3‑statement financial models with sensitivities and scenarios (base, downside, management); create cash flow forecasts, liquidity bridges, and valuation‑ready modules (DCF, comps, transaction comps).
  • Reconcile and clean raw data (GL exports, bank data, SaaS metrics) into analysis‑ready formats; maintain version control, audit trails, and traceability from trial balance to model.
  • Design board and investor reporting templates, KPI dashboards, and variance analysis frameworks; build SaaS metrics (ARR/MRR bridges, churn, LTV/CAC, NRR) and recurring revenue templates.
  • Produce deal‑ready schedules for buy‑side and sell‑side engagements (QofE, NWC, closing adjustments); translate model outputs into charts and visuals for investment memorandums and management presentations.
  • Follow strict QA processes (FAST/SMART methodology); double‑check every formula, input, and output—flawless work, transparency through assumptions pages, error checks, and version logs.
Requirements
  • 3–6 years of experience in M&A, Transaction Services, or FP&A, ideally from a Tier 1 investment bank or M&A boutique.
  • Strong experience working with software companies; exposure to deeptech (e.g., chipmakers) is a plus.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency (array formulas, Power Query, dynamic formulas, structured references).
  • Excellent grasp of valuation and deal mechanics (NWC, closing adjustments, leakage, earn‑outs).
  • Ability to turn messy data into clear historicals and models—quickly and accurately.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills—able to explain the story behind the numbers.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and ability to self‑check work before submission.
Nice‑to‑Haves
  • Experience preparing materials for investment memorandums (IMs).
  • Familiarity with CAPEX modelling and debt structuring.
  • Previous experience in software or SaaS transactions; exposure to deeptech deals a bonus.
How Our Client Works
  • They own the numbers — every figure must be backed by logic, traceability, and quality assurance.
  • They balance precision with practicality — models should be easy to hand over and fast to update.
  • They translate numbers into narratives — this role will eventually expand into creating investment memorandums where financial insights tell the story.
Recruitment Process
  • Initial Interview
  • Finance Case + bonus assignment
  • Second Interview
  • Final Interview

  • Are fluent in English (C1 level) and can clearly explain technical details to non‑technical users.
  • Have experience working directly with clients via written communication and video calls.
  • Understand APIs and JSON structures and can analyze or test requests.
  • Have solid knowledge of CX platforms such as Tidio, Zendesk, HubSpot, or Salesforce.

  • Hands‑on growth and technical mastery—deepen your technical and soft skills by implementing solutions that are often critical for clients’ business success.
  • Ownership and cross‑functional impact—lead end‑to‑end complex projects, collaborate with cross‑functional teams, and make a direct impact on both client success and Tidio’s growth.
  • Work with a team that continually shares knowledge and is not afraid of testing new solutions.
  • Remote work model with flexible hours.

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Diagnosticar e acompanhar o portador de transtorno mental, articular os recursos da rede para oferecer a melhor combinação de estratégias de cuidado, de maneira individualizada, em cada fase do tratamento e apoiar as equipes e profissionais, realizando atividades de educação permanente e utilizando a ferramenta do apoio matricial.

Requirements and skills
  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina
  • Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Psiquiatria
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico em Psiquiatria
Additional information

Hospital Municipal Pedro II/ CER Santa Cruz - RJ

Carga horária: 12h ou 24h semanais

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

description:

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Realizar e interpretar exames, diagnosticar e tratar doenças, através da visualização de ossos, órgãos ou estruturas através exames radiológicos e de imagens em geral, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde.

Título de Especialista em Radiologia

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe

Local de trabalho: Santa Cruz - RJ

24 horas semanais - Sexta-feira

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: SUPERVISOR DE CORTE
description:
Para você que se identifica e gosta de moda: a ViX Paula Hermanny está procurando um supervisor de corte que será responsável por realizar o acompanhamento das peças a serem cortadas de acordo com o risco e ordem de corte, controle dos modelos e datas de saída de cada pedido, solicitação material e conferência.

Principais atividades:

  1. Planejamento e Organização do Corte
    • Organizar a programação de corte de acordo com a demanda de produção.
    • Definir os materiais e insumos necessários para cada lote de produção.
    • Planejar a sequência de cortes, levando em consideração a otimização do uso de tecido e o aproveitamento máximo do material disponível.
  2. Gestão de Equipe
    • Supervisionar a equipe de corte, garantindo que todos os colaboradores cumpram os padrões e procedimentos estabelecidos.
    • Treinar novos colaboradores e promover o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe.
    • Realizar a gestão de turnos, escalas e garantir a disciplina e motivação da equipe.
  3. Controle de Qualidade
    • Garantir que os cortes sejam realizados com precisão, seguindo os moldes e especificações do design.
    • Identificar e corrigir problemas de qualidade no corte, como falhas nos moldes ou irregularidades no tecido.
    • Realizar inspeções regulares para verificar a conformidade com as normas de qualidade estabelecidas pela empresa.
  4. Acompanhamento de Produção
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção e verificar se o cronograma de corte está sendo cumprido.
    • Resolver eventuais problemas que possam surgir durante o processo, como falta de material, erro no corte, ou necessidade de ajustes no molde.
    • Realizar a comunicação constante com outros setores, como modelagem, produção e acabamento, para garantir a fluidez do processo.
  5. Gestão de Materiais e Recursos
    • Controlar o estoque de tecidos, garantir o uso adequado dos materiais e evitar desperdícios.
    • Acompanhar a manutenção e conservação das máquinas de corte.
    • Identificar a necessidade de reposição de materiais e insumos e realizar os pedidos de reposição.
  6. Relatórios e Acompanhamento de Resultados
    • Gerar relatórios periódicos sobre a produtividade, desperdícios e eficiência do processo de corte.
    • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e sugerir melhorias para otimização do processo.
    • Garantir que os custos com o processo de corte estejam dentro do orçamento estabelecido.
  7. Segurança e Normas
    • Garantir que os procedimentos de segurança sejam seguidos, minimizando riscos de acidentes durante o processo de corte.
    • Cumprir com as normas ambientais, de saúde e segurança no trabalho, implementando ações de prevenção de acidentes.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  1. Ensino médio completo.
  2. Liderança e capacidade de gerenciamento de equipes;
  3. Conhecimento técnico sobre o processo de corte, tipos de tecidos e materiais.
  4. Habilidade para trabalhar com sistemas de controle de produção e relatórios.
  5. Atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de solucionar problemas rapidamente.
  6. Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com outros departamentos.

Local de trabalho: São Cristóvão - RJ, 100% presencial.

description:

Software Engineering Manager - Container and Virtualisation Infrastructure

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Container and Virtualisation Infrastructure role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Our mission is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality microservice architectures and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux kernel, virtualisation, storage and networking.

LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

The successful candidate will have experience leading successful, collaborative engineering teams, and demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems and deep knowledge of Linux.

Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.

What you will focus on

  • Lead a team of remote engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Participate in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engage with teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Work from home with global travel for 4 to 6 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You understand modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8s
  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills
  • You have experience programming in C and/or Go.

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!


WHAT YOU WILL DO

Client engagement & Pre-sales
- Act as a trusted advisor in the pre-sales process, confidently engaging with potential clients to understand their vision, challenges, and goals.
- Provide strategic product consulting , helping clients refine their product direction and align their vision with actionable roadmaps.
- Lead and facilitate discovery sessions, ensuring a structured approach to defining business problems and opportunities.

- Work closely with internal teams to shape compelling proposals that align with the client’s business needs.
- Provide strategic recommendations on product direction, market positioning, and user experience.
- Define and estimate design efforts , contributing to proposal timelines and approaches.
- Advocate for user-centered design , ensuring that proposals include practical, impactful design solutions.
Design leadership & Execution
- Facilitate prototyping efforts , especially in the early stages of engagement, driving/creating napkin/high-level prototypes/concepts when needed.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align design with business strategy and technical feasibility.
- Guide design decisions that enhance user experience while considering business and technological constraints.
- Building the Center of Excellence (CoE) for Product Management.
- Establish best practices for product management and strategic design within the company.
- Growing the team of product owners, upskill team on product thinking, user research methodologies, and market validation techniques.
- Develop frameworks and guidelines that help teams deliver high-quality product strategies across projects.
- Advocate for a product-driven culture, ensuring teams maintain a balance between business needs, user needs, and technical execution.
Agility & Adaptability
- Comfortably switch between different projects, industries, and challenges , adapting quickly to new client needs.
- Excel in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and ambiguous situations.
- Take initiative in problem-solving, stakeholder management, and cross-team collaboration.
Communication & Influence
- Communicate complex ideas clearly and persuasively, ensuring alignment across stakeholders.
- Foster strong relationships with c lients, internal teams, and leadership , acting as a bridge between business and design.
- Confidently present, justify, and defend design and product decisions to both internal and external audiences.

MUST HAVES

-Executive/Managerial experience: Conduct meeting with executive stakeholders (C-level, VPs, Directors, etc), creating and driving presentations that showcase strategic thinking with a clear business impact.
- Experience: 3+ years in Executive roles such as Director/Head/VP of Product Strategy, and/or 5+ years of Manager roles in Product Management and UX Design, or Product Strategy and UX Design roles.
- Expertise in Product Strategy: Ability to define, refine, and validate product concepts with clients.
- Strong UX Background: Hands-on experience in wireframing, prototyping, and user research.
- Consultative Mindset: Experience working with clients, facilitating workshops, and shaping product visions.
- Business Acumen: Understanding of market trends, competitive analysis, and product-market fit.
- E xcellent Communication: Comfortable leading client discussions, presenting ideas, and influencing stakeholders.
- English: Upper-Intermediate level.

THE BENEFITS OF JOINING US

- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.

- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.

The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.

As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on an end-to-end data analytics and mlops solution composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. Your team will own a solution from the analytics and machine learning space, and integrate with the solutions from other teams to build the world's best end-to-end data platform. We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Canonical is a growing international software company that works with the open-source community to deliver Ubuntu, "the world's best free software platform". Our services help businesses worldwide to reduce costs, improve efficiency and enhance security with Ubuntu.

title: Danielle Bibas é nomeada CEO da Pierre Fabre
description:
Com longo histórico na Avon e passagem de um ano pelo Grupo Petrópolis executiva substitui Ana Paula Magri. Danielle Bibas acaba de assumir o cargo de chief executive officer (CEO) da filial brasileira da companhia francesa Pierre Fabre, sediada no Rio de Janeiro.

Ela substitui Ana Paula Magri, que havia sido a primeira pessoa brasileira a ocupar o comando da empresa no País.

Com isso, Danielle estará à frente do negócio que, no Brasil, comercializa as marcas Eau Thermal Avène (marca francesa especializada em dermocosméticos e uma das líderes em venda na Europa), Ducray (também francesa e focada em alta ciência e medicalização) e Darrow Laboratório (marca brasileira de dermocosméticos para pele oleosa e que, segundo a empresa faz sucesso entre a GenZ e começou a ser exportada para outros países da América Latina recentemente).

Danielle trabalhou como CMO do Grupo Petrópolis de setembro de 2022 a setembro de 2023, mas antes disso teve um longo histórico na Avon.

Na companhia de beleza, onde trabalhou por 12 anos, ocupou os cargos de CMO no Brasil e vice-presidente de marketing global. Imediatamente antes da Avon, também teve um histórico de 16 anos na P&G, onde também lidou com a categoria de saúde e beleza, tendo seu último cargo por lá sido o de presidente de Health and Beauty Care, no Canadá.

Metas estabelecidas

Há dois anos, a filial brasileira da Pierre Fabre – cujo faturamento global gira em torno de € 2,8 bilhões – ocupava a 10ª posição no mapa da companhia. E a então CEO, Ana Paula, afirmava que o objetivo era que o Brasil subisse cinco posições nesse ranking, dobrando o tamanho dos negócios até 2026.

Na cidade de Areal, no Rio de Janeiro, está instalada a única fábrica da Pierre Fabre fora da França. E desde 2018 o País também abriga o Brazilian Innovation Center (BIC), focado no desenvolvimento de produtos para a população local.

description:
HR Business Partner, People eXperience and Technology (PXT) - HR

At Amazon, we are committed to being the safest place to work in the world, the best employer, and the most customer-centric company. To get there, we need exceptionally talented and empathetic people who are passionate about making each day better for all employees — and you will play a crucial role in this journey! Our People eXperience & Technology (PXT - Human Resources) professionals care deeply about the employee experience and support employees and leaders in focusing on people through engagement, technology, and innovation.

Responsibilities
  • In this position, you will be responsible for the PXT (People eXperience and Technology - Human Resources) agenda in an Amazon warehouse located in São João de Meriti - RJ. The generalist role in HR will involve staffing and workforce management in different hiring formats, internal communication and employee engagement, leadership development at supervisor to managerial levels, general coordination of labor and employee relations issues, consolidation and reporting of metrics (absenteeism, attrition, fill rates), indirect coordination of shuttle transportation and restaurant, continuous improvement plans for employee experience, Diversity and Inclusion programs, among others.
  • Work with a team of HR Assistants to create the best experience for employees.
  • Lead the reporting and analysis of HR metrics and goals.
  • Participate in "Daily Dive Deep – DDD" meetings along with the Operations team and other support areas.
  • Co-lead workforce planning meetings, execution of staffing and terminations.
  • Conduct "Gemba" and monitor operational processes in the "shop-floor".
  • Monitor the environment from a labor and employee relations perspective, identifying trends and risks.
  • Participate in Brazil PXT Operations team meetings, reporting metrics and indicators of your operation.
  • Lead PXT and multidisciplinary projects that go beyond your work unit.
  • Promote and model an inclusive environment for all employees through specific programs, local initiatives, and affinity groups.
  • Support employee inquiries and situations with discretion and experience, along with routine standard work on employee onboarding, performance management, engagement processes, and benefits services.
  • Train, develop, and support leadership through decision-making.
  • Collaborate with various levels of the organization, from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  • Influence and guide partners to prioritize employee experience and customer obsession.
About the team

We could be a great match if you:

  • Are excited to work in a fast-paced and team-oriented environment.
  • Are enthusiastic about working in a production environment (logistics warehouse) engaging our teams, training our leaders, and creating the best place in the world to work.
  • Are excited about generalist positions where each day you will deal with various Human Resources topics.
  • Are enthusiastic about flexing your routine when necessary, making room to occasionally work night shifts or weekends, in an operation that runs 24/7 every day of the year.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
  • Completed Bachelors Degree
  • Generalist experience in Human Resources subsystems.
  • Experience in supporting massive and operational client groups (factories, warehouses, call centers, etc).
  • Fluent Portuguese and intermediate to advanced English (reads and writes easily and fluently, understands ~75% when listening and can provide quick and objective answers).
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Excel at an intermediate level (V-lookup and pivot tables).
  • Must be willing to work 100% on-site, with flexibility in hours and days, especially during peak periods or promotions (Prime Day, Black Friday).
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience in HR for factory/manufacturing, transportation company, distribution center, or logistics.
  • Masters and/or Post-Degree.
  • Data Analytics.
  • BI tools and knowledge.

Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) – Agoda

Join to apply for the Senior Product Manager (Bangkok-based) role at Agoda .

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose - Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding and happiness. We are a skillful, driven and diverse team from across the globe, united by a passion to make an impact. Harnessing our innovative technologies and strong partnerships, we aim to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Your opportunity

This role is BANGKOK-BASED, RELOCATION PROVIDED. Our Senior Product Managers are analytical and data-driven individuals, responsible for building products end-to-end, focusing on analyzing and experimenting until our solutions are perfectly tailored to our travelers. You will drive product strategy and partner closely with senior leadership cross-functionally to define, build, and deliver the best travel solutions. You will get dedicated engineering resources that you, and only you, define and allocate. We expect you to have a hands-on mentality and spend considerable time with your SCRUM teams, have enthusiasm to develop engineered processes and technologies and apply innovative solutions to make organizational improvements. Product Managers can modify every system we have in our company to suit their needs.

By applying to this role, you'll be considered for a role either in User Experience, Marketing, Finance or Supply product vertical. The goal is to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, competencies, and where you will have the most impact. We’re looking for Senior Product Managers for every part of our business. Our entire Product team sits in Bangkok. This is an Individual Contributor position.

You will get to:

  • Analyze the online travel ecosystem, markets, competitive landscape and user requirements
  • Conceptualize, launch and optimize products and features, experiment, test their performance and iterate quickly
  • Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal and UX teams on cutting-edge technologies
  • Develop innovative solutions to some of the world’s difficult problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions

What you'll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or similar quantitative discipline)
  • Proven ability to leverage analytics and quantitative methods to inform and influence decision-making
  • Strong data skills
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal and written in English) with proven ability to convey complex messages clearly to different stakeholders
  • Experience developing and launching products
  • Experience leading global product vision, go-to-market strategy and design discussions
  • Entrepreneurial and analytical skills; effective at breaking down complex problems and driving and managing change
  • Hands-on mentality

Nice to have:

  • MBA or Master’s degree in Math, Economics, Computer Science or Statistics
  • Data tools - SQL, Python, R, or equivalent

RINA is currently recruiting for a Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer to join its office in Rio de Janeiro within theOperations and Maintenance Engineering Division.

Mission

The Senior Asset Integrity RBI Engineer plays a pivotal role in optimizing inspection strategies within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant by implementing risk-based inspection methodologies. Their mission is to assess the integrity of equipment and facilities, prioritize inspection activities based on risk assessment, and develop cost-effective inspection plans to ensure asset reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance. #LI-KM

Key Accountabilities

Risk Assessment and Analysis:

  • Conduct risk assessments of equipment and infrastructure using RBI methodologies.
  • Identify and evaluate potential failure modes, consequences, and likelihood of failure.
  • Analyze risk data to prioritize inspection activities according to risk levels.

Inspection Planning and Optimization:

  • Develop risk-based inspection plans tailored to specific equipment and process units.
  • Determine appropriate inspection techniques, frequencies, and inspection intervals based on risk assessment results.
  • Optimize inspection schedules to minimize downtime and maximize asset integrity.

Data Management and Documentation:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of inspection data, risk assessments, and inspection plans.
  • Utilize software tools and databases to manage RBI data and documentation effectively.
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of RBI data for informed decision-making.

Continuous Improvement and Compliance:

  • Identify opportunities for optimization and improvement of RBI processes and methodologies.
  • Stay abreast of industry developments, best practices, and regulatory requirements related to RBI and asset integrity management.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, codes, and regulations governing inspection activities.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Communicate RBI findings, recommendations, and inspection plans to stakeholders, including engineering teams, inspection and asset integrity personnel, and management.
  • Foster a culture of safety, reliability, and continuous improvement within the organization.
Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering General or Chemical Engineering

Qualifications
  • Extensive experience in risk-based inspection, integrity management, or asset reliability engineering within the Oil & Gas facilities or power plant industry.
  • Proficiency in RBI methodologies, such as API RP 580/581, ASME PCC-3, or equivalent standards,

QUEM SOMOS
Somos uma rede de hostels no Rio de Janeiro com 20 anos de experiência no mercado.

EMPRESA
El Misti Hostels

LOCALIZAÇÃO
Ipanema, Rio de Janeiro/RJ

CONTRATO
CLT (Efetivo)

DESCRIÇÃO

Gestão Operacional:
Supervisionar a preparação e o serviço de alimentos, garantindo o cumprimento de padrões de qualidade e segurança alimentar. Planejar e organizar a rotina da cozinha, incluindo horários de produção e operação.
Monitorar o tempo de produção e garantir que os prazos sejam cumpridos.

Liderança de Equipe:
Liderar e treinar a equipe de cozinheiros, distribuindo tarefas e monitorando a performance. Coordenar escalas de trabalho, garantindo que a equipe esteja adequada às demandas do serviço. Resolver conflitos e promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo.

Controle de Estoque e Pedidos:
Controlar o estoque de ingredientes, verificar a necessidade de reposição e fazer pedidos de insumos. Gerenciar o armazenamento adequado dos alimentos e o controle de desperdício.
Realizar inventários periódicos e garantir a utilização eficiente dos produtos.

Garantia de Padrões de Higiene e Segurança:
Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de higiene e segurança alimentar em todas as etapas da produção.
Realizar inspeções periódicas e corrigir possíveis desvios nos procedimentos de limpeza e manipulação de alimentos.

Desenvolvimento e Aperfeiçoamento de Cardápios:
Colaborar no desenvolvimento de novos pratos e na melhoria do cardápio, considerando custos, qualidade e tendências. Ajustar o cardápio conforme feedback dos clientes e da equipe, mantendo a inovação e a diversidade nas opções oferecidas.

Controle Financeiro:
Gerenciar o custo dos alimentos, mantendo a operação dentro do orçamento estabelecido. Analisar relatórios de custos e desperdícios, sugerindo melhorias para otimização de recursos.

Manutenção de Equipamentos:
Monitorar o uso adequado dos equipamentos de cozinha e solicitar manutenções ou substituições quando necessário. Garantir a correta limpeza e conservação dos utensílios e maquinários.

Apoio ao Atendimento:
Trabalhar em parceria com a equipe de atendimento para garantir que os pratos sejam servidos corretamente e dentro dos padrões exigidos. Resolver problemas relacionados a pedidos de clientes e adaptar a produção quando necessário.

Horário de trabalho:

  • Turno de 8 horas

REMUNERAÇÃO:
R$2092.- Mais Comissões.

BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Vale Transporte
  • Vale Alimentação

Consultor Especialista em Processos II | Rio de Janeiro - Híbrido

Brazil - Rio de Janeiro

O profissional será responsável pela análise crítica e pela gestão de planos de ação, além de propor soluções para problemas relacionados aos projetos da Gerência Executiva.

  • Atuação na área de gestão e processos, com foco no suporte e execução de tarefas operacionais de complexidade média. Será responsável pela análise estruturada de dados e informações, consolidada de levantamentos, além de apoiar e eventualmente orientar a realização das atividades relacionadas ao desenvolvimento de soluções e implementação de melhorias na gestão da rotina e dos processos da Gerência Executiva.
  • Suporte na estruturação de documentos, relatórios e apresentações; validação, análise e proposição de conteúdos; e desenvolvimento de soluções de média complexidade no atendimento das demandas na área (subeixo) em que atua. O escopo de atividades envolve pesquisas (levantamento, estruturação e consolidação de dados), análise crítica de informações consolidadas, planejamento, estruturação e execução de relatórios e apresentações, preparação de reuniões, eventos (palestras, treinamentos, workshops, reuniões gerenciais, etc.), geração de conteúdos e desenvolvimento de soluções para as demandas de trabalho, garantindo excelência, alta qualidade, desempenho e atendimento tempestivo às demandas junto às gerências que prestarão serviço.
  • Pesquisar, estruturar e consolidar informações para a composição de documentos, relatórios e pareceres relacionados à gestão das rotinas e dos processos, promovendo a consolidação, revisão e disponibilização para a avaliação e validação final dos profissionais que atuam nas demandas de complexidade alta e gestor líder da CONTRATADA, além de gestores e especialistas da PETROBRAS.
  • Será também responsável pela estruturação do material das RACs (Reuniões de Análise Crítica) e pela gestão e controle dos indicadores de desempenho e metas das gerências, com geração de alertas, levantamento do histórico e comportamento dos indicadores e metas, realização de análise crítica e estruturação da visão prospectiva e evolutiva dos resultados ao longo do ano. Deverão propor planos de ação em caso de desvios ou riscos de cumprimento de metas, cujo conteúdo e formatação deverão ser previamente avaliados e validados pelo gestor líder, antes de serem apresentados aos gestores e especialistas da PETROBRAS nos respectivos RACs de resultados gerenciais.
  • Prestar suporte direto na estruturação e desenvolvimento das propostas de indicadores de desempenho, incluindo, mas não se limitando ao levantamento de insumos, alimentação de sistemas, análises de resultados, elaboração de materiais para validação gerencial e revisões de insumos.
  • Os processos, atividades e tarefas atreladas a este quadrante de prestação de serviços são de complexidade média e exigem conhecimento específico, capacitação e experiência. Envolvem conteúdo analítico para estruturação, gestão e controle de planos de ação no tratamento de demandas específicas na área/eixo de atuação, com vistas de garantir resultados para a respectiva gestão que atuar.
  • Deverá também controlar processos e atividades tais como: apuração de resultados de indicadores, identificação de anomalias e desvios de processos, organização de RACs gerenciais, preparação de apresentações e relatórios para apoio gerencial, controle do avanço de tarefas dos Planos de Ação e Iniciativas Estratégicas, mapeamento e desenho de fluxos de processos, entre outras atribuições correlatas.
  • Graduação: Administração, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Direito, Economia, Análise de Tecnologia da Informação, Administrador de Tecnologia da Informação ou outras áreas correlatas à especialidade.
  • Experiência de atuação nas seguintes especialidades: Gestão Empresarial, Gestão Estratégica, Gestão por Resultados, Gestão Ágil, Gestão de Processos ou outras áreas correlatas à especialidade.
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal e escrita, com habilidade para facilitar interações entre áreas diversas.
  • Proatividade na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e entrega de soluções.
  • Domínio das ferramentas: Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word e MS Project.
  • Experiência de atuação na área.
  • Regime Hibrído, com disponibilidade para atuar no Rio de Janeiro 3 dias por semana.

title: Ubuntu Core Software Engineer
description:

Join to apply for the Ubuntu Core Software Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in the embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.

Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.

As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.

Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.

Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region

The role entails

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with C or Golang, and Shell
  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
  • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
  • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
  • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
  • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto
What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity , we will give your application fair consideration.

We are hiring Rust Engineering Leads of all levels of experience to drive the adoption of this exciting language into the full range of Canonical offerings, starting with Ubuntu but also our own projects and open source offerings. We see Rust as an important new language for system level services and capabilities, and a natural evolution path for the sort of software that would traditionally have been written in C or C++. We believe that there is an opportunity to rethink the foundations of future Linux systems with Rust as a central driver of change in everything from the system firmware and embedded software, bootloaders, up through the kernel and input handling, all the way to the desktop.

We also want to ensure that Ubuntu is the very best platform for Rust development, offering easy access to the widest range of tooling and capabilities that support cutting edge open source and enterprise development.

This job posting is our general process for Rust engineers of all levels of seniority, for all relevant teams at Canonical. Apply here if you are an exceptional software engineer who prefers to work in Rust. After the first round of interviews we'll find the best fit product team at Canonical for you to progress your application based on your personal interests.

Canonical has substantial projects in Python, Go, C, C++ and we are starting to invest in Rust. For front-end development we prefer React and Flutter.

Join us in our mission to deliver innovative open-source solutions to individuals and enterprises around the world. We expect the highest engineering standards and strong motivation to get things done well in a fully home-based and distributed environment. title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Join to apply for the Chief Operating Officer (COO) role at InPlanet

Join to apply for the Chief Operating Officer (COO) role at InPlanet

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Direct message the job poster from InPlanet

About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany Brazil and the US with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.

Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast.

Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens.

You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to see how people experience the interview process with us.

Check out our Culture page here

About The Role

Informative Video by Matyas

Hybrid, with travel in Brazil

Language Skills: Must: Portuguese, English (fluent)

Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We are searching for a seasoned, strategic, commercial, and hands-on COO to lead and shape our go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors and evolve our operational backbone. In this role, you’ll oversee our entire value chain - from mineral inputs and field operations to our internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

This is a rare opportunity to refine product-market fit , identify scalable customer use cases, lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling in one of the world’s most promising carbon removal approaches. On the operational front, you will work closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations , who leads the charge on regional management, farmer acquisition, and the logistical execution of rock powder spreading across Brazil. You’ll work hand-in-hand with our VP of Science , ensuring that our field strategy is aligned with our scientific standards, operational goals, and long-term climate impact targets - building a delivery system that is not only efficient, but deeply trusted by our farming partners.

As a core strategic and visionary player, you’ll work cross-functionally to ensure our product offering is differentiated and delivers real agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements. You’ll be responsible for orchestrating our 1-100 scale-up journey : evolving early pilots into robust, repeatable, and high-impact operations at national scale.

We’re at a tipping point of scale, with growing complexity across teams, partners, and international ecosystems. The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , ideally in Brazilian agribusiness , and can bridge execution with innovation.

You will report directly to the CEO and be a critical member of our Senior Leadership Team alongside our CFO. You’ll directly lead a large and growing team, including:

  • Head of Operations and all project deployment teams including Supply and Regional Managers
  • Our Science team, in close partnership with the VP of Science
  • Collaboration with Carbon, and Technology teams
  • Strategic collaboration with our Chief Impact Officer, and commercial partners

You’ll play a central role in aligning science, fieldwork, and operations , ensuring we stay ahead in the rapidly evolving climate and carbon removal landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations

  • You’ll help define and scale a novel carbon removal product - taking it from early traction to being a key player in agriculture and mining. This is a 1-100 leadership role, demanding bold strategy, deep market insight, and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil, with scalability in mind.
  • Translate InPlanet’s carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement through operational KPIs, systemisation, and performance data.

Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership

  • You’ll drive go-to-market strategies that bring breakthrough mineral products into entrenched agricultural systems, building the trust and partnerships needed for national adoption. Commercial creativity and strategic grit will be essential.
  • Build strategic partnerships with input suppliers, logistics providers, agricultural service firms, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder - from mine to farm.
  • Ensure operational excellence and compliance with carbon standards, farmer requirements, and regulatory frameworks.

Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment

  • Collaborate with Science, Carbon, and Technology teams to ensure smooth integration of R&D, field trials, and data flows.
  • You’ll bridge science and market, ensuring our product not only works in trials but wins in the real world. Field feedback will shape product evolution and create operational systems that scale with credibility and speed.
  • Support the legal team to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.

Team & Culture Building

  • You’ll build a leadership culture that’s entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable - turning high performers into high-impact owners. Your teams will know not just what to do, but why it matters.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You’ve scaled something from messy beginnings to market success - ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary but pragmatic - able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

title: Lead ML Engineer, Recommendation Systems
description:
Overview

As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology.

Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

We convert audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and continuous optimization.

We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems) to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

MUST HAVE

You’ve shipped large-scale ML systems into production that power personalization at scale. You’re fluent in ranking algorithms and know how to turn data into engagement and conversions. Specifically:

  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices
YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

OUTCOMES
  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability
COMPETENCIES
  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other legally protected characteristics.

Contact and Application

title: Projetista de Tubulação III
description:
Sobre a vaga:

O Projetista de Tubulação será responsável pela modelagem, detalhamento e desenvolvimento de projetos de sistemas de tubulação aplicados a embarcações, plataformas e estruturas offshore. Esse profissional terá papel essencial na elaboração de desenhos técnicos, isométricos e listas de materiais, assegurando que todas as soluções estejam alinhadas com os requisitos técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios da indústria naval e offshore.

Rotina de trabalho:

Trabalhar na Proper Marine é integrar uma equipe multidisciplinar altamente qualificada, com foco em excelência técnica, inovação e segurança. Nosso ambiente estimula a troca de conhecimento, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a entrega de soluções eficientes, com espaço para autonomia, criatividade e crescimento profissional.

Formação e experiência:

  • Curso Técnico completo em Projetos Mecânicos, Tubulação, Mecânica, Engenharia Naval ou áreas afins.

  • Desejável formação complementar em Engenharia ou cursos de especialização em tubulação industrial/naval.

  • Registro no CREA (para técnicos ou tecnólogos).

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos atuando como projetista de tubulação em ambientes navais, offshore ou óleo & gás.

  • Vivência com projetos de sistemas complexos de tubulação a bordo de FPSOs, embarcações de apoio marítimo, sondas, plataformas fixas ou módulos industriais.

Principais responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver e revisar modelos 3D de tubulação usando ferramentas específicas (AutoCAD Plant 3D, E3D, PDMS, Navisworks).

  • Elaborar isométricos, desenhos ortogonais, layouts e listas de materiais (BOM/MTO).

  • Realizar roteamento de linhas considerando espaço, interferências, suporte, manutenção e acessibilidade.

  • Participar de revisões de projeto (model review) com equipes multidisciplinares, propondo soluções de engenharia.

  • Garantir que os desenhos estejam em conformidade com os P&IDs, normas de classe e diretrizes do projeto.

  • Verificar interferências e colisões (clash detection) junto às disciplinas de estrutura, elétrica e instrumentação.

  • Preparar documentação técnica de apoio à fabricação e montagem.

  • Colaborar com engenheiros e coordenadores de projeto na definição de especificações e padrões técnicos.

  • Apoiar na compatibilização de disciplinas e interface com fornecedores e estaleiros quando necessário.

Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills):

  • Domínio em ferramentas de modelagem e detalhamento de tubulação:

  • AutoCAD Plant 3D, E3D, PDMS, Navisworks, SmartPlant ou equivalentes.

  • Leitura e interpretação de diagramas de processo (P&ID), fluxogramas, plantas e cortes.

  • Conhecimento em:

  • Materiais e classes de tubulação (carbono, inox, duplex, cobre-níquel etc.)

  • Componentes de sistemas de tubulação: válvulas, flanges, suportes, juntas de expansão, etc.

  • Normas e códigos aplicáveis: ASME B31.3 / B31.1, API, NORSOK, ISO, NR-13, entre outros.

  • Noções de cálculo de suportação e esforço, embora não seja um cargo de engenharia.

  • Experiência com sistemas típicos de embarcações e offshore, como:

  • Sistemas de lastro, incêndio, ar-condicionado, combustível, ar comprimido, água potável e esgoto.

  • Familiaridade com práticas de projeto naval, requisitos de classe (DNV, ABS, BV).

  • Formação mínima técnica em Mecânica, Naval, Civil, Estruturas ou áreas afins
  • +5 anos de experiência em projetos de estruturas metálicas no setor naval, offshore ou industrial
  • Domínio de FEMAP e sólida experiência em método dos elementos finitos (FEA)
  • Conhecimento em softwares de modelagem 3D/CAD (ex.: Tekla, Aveva, AutoCAD, SolidWorks )

  • Inglês técnico (leitura e escrita).

  • Atuação em projetos de unidades flutuantes, embarcações ou sistemas offshore
  • Certificações ou especializações em estruturas metálicas, FEA ou integridade estrutural
Soft Skills

  • Análise crítica e capacidade de tomada de decisão baseada em dados
  • Comunicação clara com times
  • Organização e priorização em projetos de alta complexidade
  • Postura colaborativa e habilidade de mentorar outros profissionais.

title: Staff Security Operations Engineer
description:
Overview

The Security Operations (SecOps) team is responsible for design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They are responsible for assuring the security and integrity of our own infrastructure and product deployments. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure security threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack.

The SecOps team’s mission is not only to secure Canonical, but also to contribute to the security of the wider open source ecosystem. They might share knowledge through public presentations and industry events, and share threat intelligence with the wider community or represent Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

What you will do in this role
  • Implement and evolve Canonical's SecOps security standards and playbooks
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work in the framework of Canonical's agile engineering practice
  • Work with Security leadership to present information and influence change
What we are looking for
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF
  • Experience with security standards such as ISO 27001
Optional things we value
  • Experience in a security operations team or a security operations centre (SOC)
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with state-actor and other advanced persistent threats
What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Fundada no Brasil em 2009, era responsável pelo marketing e pelo apoio da distribuição de toda a região. Vale Refeição (R$ 945,00) e Vale Alimentação (R$300,00)

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico Bradesco

Total Pass

C4 Life - Assistência psicológica, financeira, jurídica e social.

  • Desenvolver laços fortes com clientes-chave e ser proativo na compreensão das tendências e questões que provavelmente impactarão o mercado.

  • Responsabilidade – Responsável por alcançar resultados e atingir os objetivos.

  • Diploma universitário completo
  • Necessário pelo menos 4 anos de experiência em vendas diretas de dispositivos médicos – Experiência em endoscopia, imagem e tecnologia preferencialmente.
  • CNH válida para recebimento do veículo corporativo como ferramenta de trabalho
  • Forte compreensão do setor de Dispositivos Médicos/Saúde.
  • Pode fornecer orientação e assistência a profissionais de vendas de nível básico e/ou funcionários de suporte.
  • 70% do tempo visitando clientes (SP) e 30% escritório.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento com os principais stakeholders da região coberta;
  • Conhecimento em CRM (Salesforce)
  • Capacidade de viajar dentro do território e internacionalmente conforme necessário.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Esta posição irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolvimento de Infraestrutura de Dados: Colaborar com o Data Architect para projetar e construir pipelines e soluções de armazenamento escaláveis e eficientes.

  • Expertise em Snowflake: Utilizar recursos avançados do Snowflake, como virtual warehouses, micro-particionamento e papéis de segurança (security roles).
  • Azure Data Factory: Desenvolver pipelines no ADF, com foco em resolução de erros e monitoramento de performance.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer, com domínio em arquitetura de dados e princípios de gestão de dados.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas (pós-graduação é um diferencial).
  • SQL
  • Snowflake
  • Python
  • Frameworks de processamento de dados como Apache Spark e Hadoop
  • Experiência prática com integrações entre sistemas e controle de versão utilizando GitHub.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas, com habilidade para lidar com grandes volumes e complexidade de dados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração, com perfil proativo e foco em trabalho em equipe.
  • Compromisso com qualidade e precisão dos dados, com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade de se adaptar a ambientes dinâmicos e de ritmo acelerado, respondendo rapidamente a mudanças de escopo ou prioridades.
